ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C1-3,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 19-G
in the area bounded by:

West Howard Street; a line 210 feet east and parallel to the alley next east of and
parallel to South Ashland Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West Howard
Street; a line 175 feet east and parallel to the alley next east of and parallel to South
Ashland Avenue

to those of a B3-3, Community Shopping District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

A. Bed eln

Maria E. Hadden
Alderman, 49" Ward

Common Addresses:
1547 W. Howard
